profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs writing classes and workshops for girls and young women, from late elementary school through high school. Its programs use the Amherst Writers & Artists method. It was launched in Oakland, California in 2013 and has published student writing in printed anthologies.

sources.title: The Intuitive Writing Project Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
AWA Affiliate Elizabeth Perlman and The Intuitive Writing Project

review.notes: Name matches exactly a 501(c)(3) (ProPublica, EIN 46-1946012) that was launched in Oakland in 2013 per the AWA blog and offers youth writing classes, fitting a no-cost MOU for classroom programs; no OUSD mention in the sources, but no conflicting same-name organization found. Summary, orgType, website, EIN and headquarters (Greenville, SC per ProPublica) are supported; the grade range in the summary comes from the AWA blog (grades 3-12), while the current website says ages 11 and up.
